description:
Website Manager – Duda Experience Preferred | Project-Based | $7–$9/hr

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Project-based / ongoing support

Estimated Hours: Approximately 10 hours/month to start; EST

Compensation: $7–$9 USD/hour based on experience

Type: Ongoing Project-Based Role | Potential for More Hours



About the Role

We are looking for a reliable Website Manager to support ongoing website updates and performance tracking for an orthodontic practice.  The ideal candidate has experience working with Duda or similar website platforms and can confidently handle periodic website updates, create new pages when needed, and provide simple monthly website performance reports. This is not a full-time role. It will begin as an ongoing project-based role with an estimated 10 hours per month, with the potential to increase as website requests come through.



What You’ll Do

Website Updates & Maintenance

Make periodic updates to the website as requested

Update text, images, service pages, team bios, blogs, and other site content

Add new website pages as needed

Check pages for formatting, layout, and mobile responsiveness

Fix minor website issues or escalate larger technical problems



Duda Website Management

Manage and update pages inside Duda

Maintain design consistency across the site

Ensure new sections or pages match the existing website style

Keep website content clean, accurate, and professional



Monthly Reporting

Provide a simple monthly website performance report

Track basic metrics such as traffic, page views, user behavior, and conversions if available

Identify issues, trends, or opportunities for improvement

Recommend small updates to improve performance and user experience



Required Experience

Experience managing or updating websites

Strong attention to detail

Ability to make clean, professional website updates

Basic understanding of website performance and reporting

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

Clear written communication

Ability to complete small requests quickly and accurately



Preferred Experience

Experience using Duda is strongly preferred

Experience with orthodontic, dental, healthcare, or local service websites

Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, or similar reporting tools

Basic understanding of SEO and user experience

Experience creating new landing pages or service pages



Who This Role Is Best For

This role is best for someone who:

Has experience managing websites

Is comfortable working on small, recurring website tasks

Knows how to maintain a clean and professional website

Can provide simple performance insights

Wants ongoing project-based work with potential for more hours



Important Notes

This is an ongoing project-based role

Estimated workload is approximately 10 hours per month to start

Hours are not guaranteed and may increase depending on client needs

Duda experience is preferred



To Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your website management experience

3. Any experience you have with Duda 

4. Links to websites you have managed, updated, or built, if available (BEST IF IN DUDA)

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Greater Houston Counseling Services (GHCS) is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Virtual Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our team remotely. This is a critical role that supports the financial health of our organization by managing accounts receivable, contacting clients to collect outstanding balances, and maintaining accurate records of payments.



The ideal candidate will have experience in accounts receivable or collections, an understanding of mental health care, and the ability to engage with clients in a meaningful, compassionate, and impactful way. As part of our administrative team, you will work closely with and report directly to the Administrative Coordinator, ensuring seamless communication and alignment with our organizational goals.



This is a highly responsible role that requires strong organizational skills, excellent English proficiency, and a client-centered approach.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts Receivable Management

- Regularly review and manage the aging report to track overdue accounts and prioritize collection efforts.

- Identify and follow up on outstanding balances, ensuring that clients are aware of their payment responsibilities.

- Update client account records to reflect payments received and any agreed-upon payment arrangements.



Client Communication

- Professionally and compassionately engage with clients via phone,
, and other communication channels to address outstanding balances.

- Clearly explain payment terms and options, ensuring clients feel supported and respected.

- Discuss and establish payment plans for clients experiencing financial challenges, aligning with GHCS policies.



Reporting and Collaboration

- Maintain detailed records of all client interactions, including follow-ups, payment agreements, and resolutions.

- Prepare weekly and monthly reports summarizing collections efforts, payments received, and trends in outstanding balances.

- Collaborate with the Administrative Coordinator to address challenges, escalate unresolved accounts, and recommend process improvements.



Compliance and Sensitivity

- Uphold confidentiality and adhere to all regulations related to client financial information, especially in the context of mental health care.

- Approach all interactions with empathy and professionalism, understanding the unique sensitivities of clients receiving mental health services.

Process Improvement

- Identify patterns in overdue accounts and suggest ways to enhance the invoicing and collections process.

- Work with the Administrative Coordinator to ensure that invoicing systems are accurate and user-friendly for clients.



Key Qualifications:

- Experience: Minimum of 2 years in accounts receivable, collections, or related roles.

- Understanding of Mental Health Care: Familiarity with the unique considerations of engaging with clients in a healthcare or counseling setting.

- Communication Skills: Exceptional English proficiency, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate clearly and empathetically.

- Technical Skills: Proficiency with accounting software, spreadsheets (e.g., Excel or Google Sheets), and CRM tools.

- Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple client accounts effectively.

- Compassionate and client-focused, with a commitment to maintaining positive relationships.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to work independently while following organizational processes.

- Proactive in identifying and addressing challenges, with a problem-solving mindset.



Compensation and Benefits:

- Base Salary: $600 USD per month.



Bonus Structure:

  - Monthly Collection Bonus:

    - Collect 50–70% of outstanding balances: $25 bonus.

    - Collect 71–90% of outstanding balances: $50 bonus.

    - Collect 91–100% of outstanding balances: $100 bonus.

  - Quarterly Performance Bonus: Additional $100 bonus for meeting or exceeding collection targets for three consecutive months.



- Other Benefits:

  - Flexible remote work schedule.

  - Ongoing training and support from the Administrative Coordinator.

  - Opportunities for growth within the administrative team.



How to Apply:

If you are organized, empathetic, and skilled in collections, we would love to hear from you! To apply, please submit:

1. Your updated resume.

2. A brief cover letter explaining your experience in accounts receivable and your understanding of mental health care.

3. A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you’re interested in this position.

Please
 your application to 
 with the subject line: Application for Virtual Accounts Receivable Specialist.



Work Hours and Expectations:

- Hours: 40 hours per week with flexible scheduling.

- Reporting Structure: Report directly to the Administrative Coordinator and collaborate on strategies and updates.

- Performance Goals: Regularly meet or exceed collection targets while maintaining professionalism and empathy in all client interactions.



Why Join Us?



At GHCS, we’re dedicated to supporting the mental health and well-being of our clients. This role provides the unique opportunity to contribute to that mission by ensuring that our services remain sustainable. If you’re passionate about helping others, managing accounts, and working in a compassionate environment, we encourage you to apply!

I am a licensed real estate agent in Ontario, Canada, running a fast-growing, client-focused business. I'm hiring one Virtual Administrative Assistant to work directly with me — no agency, no middlemen — in a long-term role with real room to grow into more hours, more responsibility, and higher pay over time.

Pay: $4–6 CAD/hour to start, based on experience. Raises tied to performance and growth.



What You'll Do

The list below is a general outline, not a fixed scope. Priorities shift weekly in a growing business. If you need a rigid task list, this role isn't for you.



CRM & database: Update records daily, log every communication, keep contacts clean and properly tagged.

Task management in ClickUp: Create, track, and surface deadlines proactively — before I ask.

Transaction coordination: Organize listing and purchase paperwork, track conditions and timelines, prepare buyer/seller checklists, flag missing documents immediately.

Google Drive: Maintain a clean, logical folder structure following my SOPs. Build and update SOPs as the business evolves.

 & follow-ups: Manage my inbox, draft replies for review, make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Reports & spreadsheets: Clean, accurate weekly tracking of KPIs and business metrics.

Social media support: Schedule and upload posts on Instagram,
, and YouTube. Organize content calendars. Light Canva design using my templates.



Not in this role: sales, negotiating, or anything requiring a license.



Required Skills (Non-Negotiable)

Google Workspace — expert level. You must be fully fluent in Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Forms. This is the backbone of my business and you'll live in these tools every day. Calendar management, advanced Sheets formulas, and clean Drive organization are not optional skills.

Claude and ChatGPT — for drafting, summarizing, cleaning data, and admin support

NotebookLM — for organizing research, notes, and reference material

Comfortable with change and new responsibilities



Workspace & Tech Requirements (Strict)



Internet: Minimum 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload, stable and reliable. A live speed test on camera is part of the interview.

As we continue expanding our AI dubbing services, we are looking for a highly proactive and organized Client Success Manager who can help deliver an exceptional client experience while ensuring projects move forward efficiently.



The Client Success Manager will serve as the main point of contact for clients after onboarding. This role is responsible for maintaining smooth communication between clients and internal teams while making sure dubbing projects stay on track, issues are escalated quickly, and clients consistently receive proactive updates regarding timelines, progress, and next steps. You will work closely with the sales, production, and technical teams to ensure nothing falls through the cracks and that every client feels fully supported throughout the process.



We are looking for someone with strong written and verbal English communication skills who has previous experience in client success, account management, client services, or a similar role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple clients, tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously. Experience using project management and CRM platforms such as 
, Notion, ClickUp, Trello, or similar tools is highly preferred.



This role requires someone who is naturally proactive and comfortable following up internally to keep projects moving forward without being passive or confrontational. You should be able to identify issues early, escalate them quickly, and maintain clear and professional communication with both clients and internal teams. Experience or familiarity with YouTube, video production, dubbing, AI tools, or the creator economy is considered a strong advantage.



JVDB Studios is a fast-moving startup environment, so we are looking for someone who takes ownership, adapts quickly, and thrives in a remote and asynchronous work setup. The right person for this role is reliable, solution-oriented, and capable of maintaining a high standard of client experience without requiring constant supervision.



How to Apply



To apply, please send your updated resume together with a video recorded introduction link explaining your background, experience, and why you believe you would be a strong fit for JVDB Studios.



Please send your application to

title: Virtual Assistant - Article Account Management (RSS + MRSS)
description:
Virtual Assistant – AI Content & WordPress Specialist (30 Articles/Day KPI)



Part-Time | Remote 



About the Role

We are looking for a fast-paced, detail-oriented Content Management Specialist to join our digital operations team. You will be responsible for a high-volume workflow that involves downloading video assets from TikTok/YouTube, generating AI-assisted articles, and publishing them to WordPress with 100% accuracy in metadata and linking.



This is a high-output role with a strict KPI of 30 completed articles per day.



Key Responsibilities

Asset Management: Identify and download video content and thumbnails from partners (e.g., Devour Power, Luke Martin, Patty Plates) using TikTok/YouTube downloaders.



File Organization: Upload assets to Google Drive using strict naming conventions (Parent folders and files must match asset titles exactly).



AI Content Generation: Use Gemini Gems and AI prompts to transform video assets into high-quality blog articles.



WordPress Publishing: Create posts, format text, and ensure the "Author" and "Category" fields match the creator perfectly (No errors allowed here).



Technical Linking: Link MRSS GUID codes to WordPress posts and ensure Lead Images/Thumbnails are correctly uploaded. 



MRSS Management: Upload videos to S3/MRSS feeds, manage metadata, and apply a strict 10-tag rule (3 Broad, 4 Niche, 3 Trending tags).



Tracking: Log all completed work in the Yahoo Article Tracking sheet.



Required Skills & Experience

WordPress Expert: You must be comfortable with the WordPress Gutenberg/Classic editor and managing sidebar metadata (Categories, Tags, Authors).



AI Savvy: Experience using Gemini or ChatGPT to generate and refine content.



Technical Accuracy: Ability to follow complex SOPs without skipping steps. You understand the importance of GUIDs and S3 naming conventions.



Speed & Efficiency: Ability to hit a daily target of 30 articles while maintaining high quality.



File Management: Proficiency in Google Drive organization and file naming protocols.



Technical Requirements

Stable, high-speed internet connection (Back-up internet is a plus).



Laptop/Desktop capable of handling video downloads and multiple browser tabs.



Experience with S3 or MRSS feeds is a significant advantage.

title: Social Media VA
description:
Virtual Assistant – Social Media & Content Partner (Not Just Posting)



Application is only considered if you request the information below and complete the task



I am looking for a Virtual Assistant who is more than task-oriented. This role is for someone who can think, feel, create, and translate real life into meaningful content.



This is not a plug-and-play position. This is a partnership for someone who understands that content is not just about visibility it’s about connection, impact, and truth.



About Me & The Work

I am a financial coach and bookkeeper firm owner, a retreat leader, a nonprofit founder in the foster care space, author and the host of a podcast centered on courage and real conversations.



My content is layered:

* Personal life and story

* Financial clarity and coaching

* Women’s retreat work

* Foster care advocacy and nonprofit mission



You will be supporting multiple brands/accounts across:

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

*

* (Eventually) TikTok



Each platform and each message requires intention, nuance, and awareness.



What This Role Actually Is

* Translating raw thoughts, voice notes, and transcripts into meaningful posts

* Helping shape and carry a message across multiple platforms

* Understanding tone shifts between audiences and platforms

* Thinking ahead, not waiting to be told what to do

* Bringing ideas, not just executing them



Who This Is For

* Have a natural instinct for social media (not just trends but connection)

* Are highly creative and can think beyond templates

* Are self-directed and proactive (you don’t wait, you move)

* Communicate clearly and confidently

* Can take feedback without ego and adjust quickly

* Understand emotional depth not everything is a “tip” post

* Can balance storytelling with strategy



Who This Is NOT For

* Need step-by-step direction for every task

* Rely heavily on generic or AI-sounding captions

* Copy/paste the same content across all platforms

* Struggle to adapt tone for different audiences

* Are only looking for a checklist-based VA role



Responsibilities

* Create and schedule content across platforms

* Adapt messaging for Instagram, LinkedIn,
 (and eventually TikTok)

* Turn raw content (voice notes, transcripts, ideas) into polished posts

* Assist with content planning and organization

* Bring new content ideas regularly

* Maintain brand voice across multiple areas of business



Application Process (Read Carefully)

To be considered, you must complete the following:



Part 1: Voice + Depth

You will be given a short piece of raw content.



Your task:

Turn it into a high-value post for:

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

This should feel human, real, and aligned not overly polished or generic.



Part 2: Creative Thinking

Create ONE original content idea you believe would perform well for this brand, different pillar of brand then from above.



Include:

* Hook

* Format (carousel, reel, talking head, etc.)

* Caption outline

* Why you chose this direction



Part 3: Platform Awareness

Show how you would slightly adjust the same message for:

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

*



Final Note

This role is not just about social media.

It is about helping communicate a message that impacts women, business owners, and foster care awareness.



If you are someone who needs constant direction, this will not be the right fit.



But if you are someone who sees the bigger picture… Who can take a message and help it land in someone’s life…



I want to hear from you. Please only apply if you plan on sending the requested content.

title: Cold Caller for AI Startup (B2B / North America) - $3/hr + Bonuses
description:
Hi everyone, I'm Asad, founder of Avidra, a small AI startup based in Toronto, Canada. We're building an AI receptionist that answers calls for small trade businesses in North America (plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians) when the owner can't pick up.



I'm looking for a part-time outbound caller to help us reach our first 100 customers. This is long-term ongoing work, not a one-off gig. I want to find someone I can grow with.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY:

- Make 80-100 outbound calls per shift using our pre-researched lead list

- Use our script and objection-handling guide (full training provided)

- Goal of every call: get permission to send our 2-minute demo video. NOT to close the sale. I close those myself afterward.

- Log every call in a Google Sheet (provided)

- Send a daily 5-minute screen recording with 2-3 actual call recordings and the common objections you heard



REQUIREMENTS:

- Strong, clear English with a neutral or North American accent. This is the most important one. Our customers are tradespeople in the US and Canada who hang up quickly on calls they cannot easily understand.

- 1+ year of B2B cold calling or outbound sales experience

- Experience with VOIP tools (we provide the account)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and screen recording tools

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, decent headset

- 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday, 9 PM to 2 AM Manila Time (this is 9 AM to 2 PM Eastern Time, the strongest pickup window for tradespeople in North America)

- B2B outbound experience only. No real estate, insurance, or MLM.



COMPENSATION:

- $3 USD per hour base, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

- $2 bonus per qualified lead (real business owner, real contact info, agreed to receive the demo)

- $20 bonus per paid customer who signs up from a lead you generated

- $10 retention bonus when that customer stays 60+ days



A solid caller with consistent conversion can land around $5-7 per hour effective rate once the bonuses are factored in.



I'll be straight with you: the base is on the lower end because we're early and bootstrapped. The bonuses are real and they're how I want this role to actually pay. If that math does not work for you, no hard feelings.



HIRE PROCESS:

1. Apply with the items below

2. 15-minute video interview if shortlisted

3. Paid 1-hour live trial ($3) where we run the script together. No free work.

4. 30-day paid probation

5. Long-term ongoing contract



WHAT I PROVIDE:

- Full script and objection-handling guide

- Pre-researched lead list with business info

- VOIP account with a North American number

- Company
 on our domain

- Standard time tracking



HOW TO APPLY:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you (Vocaroo, SoundCloud, or any audio host works)

2. Your years of B2B cold calling experience and the specific industries you have called into

3. Your typical daily call volume in past roles

4. Your time zone in Manila Time and the shift hours you can work



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. I need to hear how you sound on a call before anything else.



Thanks for reading.



— Asad

title: Appointment Setter (Inbound Sales) PST hours
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

ABOUT US



We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.



Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.



This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.



- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time



The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.





KPI TARGETS



This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.



- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160





WHAT WE NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls.



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. We need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.



Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer.





REQUIREMENTS



- 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone)

- Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day)

- Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace

- Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process

- Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used

- Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines)



NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone)

- Experience with Stripe payment links

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care



COMPENSATION



- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.



To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.





HOW TO APPLY



Submit a link to your updated resume, and Please send me a cover letter explaining:



1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume)

2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule

3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan

4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

title: Dropship & Retail Operations Specialist
description:
IMPORTANT NOTE - We are specifically looking for candidates based in Manila, Philippines for this role. Distilled Strategy is a 10099-based / contractor workforce. You will be required to work US hours (EST) regardless of your location.

About Distilled Strategy



Distilled Strategy is a high-velocity design and strategy partner for the world’s most complex industries: Fintech, HealthTech, and B2B SaaS. We help startups and enterprises move from archaic and clunky to intuitive and fundable. Our work has helped clients raise over $170M+, and we pair strategic design with emerging tools—AI included—to modernize how businesses operate and grow.



Who We Are

We’re a gregarious crew of designers, strategists, and developers. We believe you produce your best work when given the freedom to work with a team you’d actually love to hang out with "off the clock". We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. 



Role Overview

The core mission of the Dropship & Retail Operations Specialist is to be unequivocally passionate about the operational health and expansion of the client’s retail channels. You serve as the single point of accountability for the digital storefronts that drive our growth target, ensuring that every product launch and high velocity retail event is executed with 100?curacy. 



This role exists to break the "Operator’s Trap". You are not here to simply react to portal requests; you are here to stabilize workflows, surface strategic insights from retailer data, and reduce leadership involvement in day to day management.



In this role, you will:

- Manage Product Launches: Own the end to end process of submitting forms, documents, and creative assets for new products across retailer portals.

- Ensure Site Integrity: Perform daily audits of retailer sites to ensure accuracy, manage out of stocks, and remove discontinued items.

- Maintain Catalog Consistency: Ensure brand messaging and product data are perfectly synchronized across all four focused channels: Direct, Dropship, TV Sales, and Flash Sales.

- Optimize via Data: Leverage unique retailer data and click through rates, to identify trends and improve performance.

- Support High Velocity Events: Coordinate operations for TV sales and flash sale retail events where timing and accuracy are critical.

- Distill Complexity: Translate complex portal blockers or inventory issues into simple, consumable information that leadership can act on



You might be a good fit for us if...

- You Ask “Why,” Not Just “What”: You don’t blindly follow instructions or system outputs. You investigate until you figure out what actually happened.

- You’re a Night Owl: You are energized working US hours (Manila night shift) to ensure same day shipping and portal updates are met.

- You Think in Systems: You enjoy understanding how a hub and spoke system connects and looking for patterns to prevent recurring catalog errors.

- Narrative Simplicity is Your Style: You can explain complex issues in a simple, "breezy" way, aiming for "9th grade legibility".

- Ownership is Your Default: When a launch stalls, you don’t wait to be told what to do; you take initiative and close the loop



Key Tech Stack

- Retailer Portals: Mirakl (Macy’s/Kohl’s), Sam’s Club Supplier Hub.

- Order Management: Extensiv (OMS), Lomax (WMS), Shopify.

- Internal Productivity: Microsoft Teams, OneNote, and AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT for data processing



Application Instructions: We value attention to detail above all else. When applying, please set your subject line to: [Your Name] | Distilled / Dropship Support. This helps us filter out automated applications and get straight to the top candidates.

title: Inventory & Operations Specialist
description:
IMPORTANT NOTE

Distilled Strategy is a 10099-based / contractor workforce. As a contractor, you are solely responsible for managing and filing your own taxes in accordance with your local jurisdiction's regulations. You will be required to work US hours (EST) regardless of your location.



About Distilled Strategy

Distilled Strategy is a high-velocity design and strategy partner for the world’s most complex industries: Fintech, HealthTech, and B2B SaaS. We help startups and enterprises move from archaic and clunky to intuitive and fundable. Our work has helped clients raise over $170M+, and we pair strategic design with emerging tools—AI included—to modernize how businesses operate and grow.



Who We Are

We’re a gregarious crew of designers, strategists, and developers. We believe you produce your best work when given the freedom to work with a team you’d actually love to hang out with "off the clock". We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. 



Role Overview

The core mission of the Inventory & Operations Strategist is to serve as the "accountant" for physical goods, providing the operational backbone for supply chain and cash allocation. You are the single point of accountability for maintaining a rolling 90-day inventory churn, ensuring the company never goes out of stock while preventing excess capital from being locked up in overstock.



This is not a traditional role focused on building large teams; it is for a hands-on expert who looks at messy, fragmented systems and thinks, "This is fixable—I can take control". You will own the "just-in-time" flow of inventory to maximize cash flexibility and significantly reduce COGS.



What You Will Do

- Own Inventory Planning: Continuously monitor and manage inventory levels across Extensiv, WMS, and spreadsheets based on approved business logic.

- Strategic Forecasting: Use math-based equations to calculate 90-day rates of sale and production timelines (often 90 days) so purchase orders land exactly when needed.

- Maintain Site & Stock Integrity: Establish and validate min/max inventory levels, ensuring an "event minimum" is always on hand while adhering to investment budgets.

- 3PL & Fulfillment Ownership: Own the day-to-day relationship with 3PL partners, pushing them on performance, accuracy, and cost to ensure smooth inbound and outbound flows.

- Logistics & Cost Management: Lead cost reduction efforts across freight and logistics; negotiate with carriers (DHL, FedEx, USPS) to drive shipping costs toward optimized targets.

- Strategic "Alert" Reporting: Act as a watchdog; proactively identify and flag risks—such as over-ordering or cost leaks—before leadership sees them.

- SKU Rationalization: Drive the simplification of the business by meaningfully decreasing the SKU count.



You might be a good fit for us if...

- You Are a Spreadsheet Expert: You are highly hands-on and comfortable doing the heavy lifting in Excel and operational analysis.

- You Are Executive Facing: You can present data-backed pushback and tradeoffs (cash vs. inventory vs. availability) clearly to leadership.

- You Act with Directional Accuracy: You can operate in messy, imperfect systems without getting stuck, focusing on outcomes over perfect data.

- You Are a Strategic Interrogator: You don't just "take orders" or purchase because a system told you to; you challenge assumptions and identify issues early.

- You Are Low Ego & Direct: You are comfortable having difficult conversations and pushing back with recommendations rather than just questions.



Application Instructions: We value attention to detail above all else. When applying, please set your subject line to: [Your Name] | Distilled / Inventory & Operations Specialist. This helps us filter out automated applications and get straight to the top candidates.

title: SEO Assistant — Organic Local Search (No GBP Work)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

We do NOT work with Google Business Profile, Google Maps, or the local Map Pack. Our sites do NOT have physical addresses. If your experience is mostly GBP optimization, Map Pack ranking, or address-based listings, this role is not a fit. We need someone who understands organic blue-link SEO for Service Area Businesses (SABs) — citations, on-page, content, internal linking, and backlinks.



About the Role

We operate a portfolio of local lead generation websites across the United States. Each site ranks in Google's organic results (NOT the Map Pack) for service-based searches like "foundation repair Albuquerque" or "basement waterproofing Omaha." These sites generate phone-call leads that we forward to local service contractors who pay per lead or monthly.

Your job is to execute the organic local SEO work that makes these sites rank without any Google Business Profile presence: building citations on SAB-safe directories only, optimizing on-page elements, writing service and city page content, monitoring rankings in Google Search Console, and researching new keyword opportunities. This is hands-on execution work — we provide the SOPs, checklists, and trackers. You follow the process and report results.

This is a long-term position. If you do great work, you grow with us as we add more sites.



The Sites You'll Work On

You will manage SEO work for our portfolio of US-based local service lead generation sites across a mix of home services niches (foundation repair, waterproofing, gate repair, artificial turf, and similar). Specific site details, business names, phone numbers, and access credentials are shared after hiring. The portfolio grows monthly — strong VAs take on more sites over time.



Daily & Weekly Responsibilities

Citation Building (primary task)



Submit 8-12 new business citations per week, split across the sites in your portfolio

Use ONLY the 15 SAB-safe directories on our approved list (listed below)

NEVER submit to Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Maps, Foursquare, BBB, Nextdoor, MapQuest, ShowMeLocal, Yellow Pages, Angi, HomeAdvisor, Houzz, or Thumbtack

Enter NAP (business name, phone, website) exactly as specified — copy/paste from the Site Portfolio reference, never retype

Use the Citation Tracker spreadsheet — record directory, status, submission date, login
, and live listing URL

Take a screenshot of every submission confirmation and save to the shared folder



On-Page SEO & Content



Audit pages for compliance with our Build SOP (title tag formula, meta description, H1, schema, internal linking)

Write fresh content for new city pages, service pages, and FAQs (we provide topic + outline; you write the draft)

Add internal links between service pages, city pages, and FAQs following the hub-and-spoke model

Flag any on-page issues (missing schema, broken canonical, wrong phone) in the Issues tracker



Ranking & Indexing Monitoring



Pull Google Search Console data weekly for all assigned sites

Update the Keyword Rankings tab with current positions for tracked keywords

Monitor sitemap indexing status; request indexing for new pages via GSC URL Inspection

Flag ranking drops of 3+ positions immediately

Send a weekly summary report every Friday (template provided)



Backlinks & Research



Identify 3-5 local backlink prospects per week (chambers of commerce, niche blogs, local news, resource pages)

Send outreach
s using provided templates

Use Mangools KWFinder for keyword research and Mangools SERPChecker for competitor SERP analysis

Identify new long-tail keyword opportunities for blog posts and city pages





Approved Citation Directories (the only ones you will use)

These are the 15 directories that accept Service Area Business listings without requiring a verified physical street address. Every citation submission must go to one of these:



Yelp

Manta

MerchantCircle

Brownbook

EZlocal

Alignable



2findlocal

Opendi

n49

Tools You Will Use

 + 
 — for daily/weekly communication



You will not need to buy any tools. All paid tools are provided.



Requirements

Must Have



1+ year of hands-on local SEO experience

Experience with citation building (must understand exact-NAP submissions)

Comfortable with Excel / Google Sheets (sorting, filtering, basic formulas)

Strong attention to detail — citation work requires accuracy more than speed

Good written English for content drafts and weekly reports

Skipping the weekly Friday report

Compensation & Schedule

Pay



$
USD/month base to start (full-time, 35-40 hours/week)

 (1-2 sentences on what you worked on)

Are you comfortable working this way? What does this change about your typical local SEO workflow vs. a business that uses GBP?

Are you applying for part-time (20 hrs/week) or full-time (35-40 hrs/week)? Confirm you understand the starting base is $400 USD/month for full-time, with raises tied to ranking milestones.



NOTE: Question 3 is the most important. We are specifically looking for VAs who either (a) have rank-and-rent / organic-only SEO experience, or (b) recognize that they'll need to unlearn some GBP-centric habits and are happy to do that. We're not looking for GBP experts — we have a different model.



Growth Potential

We are actively building new lead generation sites every month. A VA who demonstrates reliability and quality work will:



Take on more sites as they launch (with corresponding pay increases)

Earn raises tied to ranking milestones (page 1 / top 5 / top 3 for tracked keywords)

Be involved in on-page content writing and internal linking as skills develop

Have a stable, long-term position as the portfolio grows



We value accuracy over speed. If you take pride in doing citation work the right way — correct NAP, organized records, consistent follow-through — and you're excited to learn an unusual SEO approach that actually works for SAB lead generation, we want to hear from you.

title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
About bina



bina is an online school for ages 6–14, building a category-defining learning experience for families that want more than what traditional or other online schools offer. We're a small, fast-moving team, currently scaling enrollment ahead of our peak intake season (Aug–Sep 2026). The next 3–4 months are when the year is made.



Why we're hiring now: We need predictable lead flow from paid + organic channels — and the Head of GTM and 6 channel specialists doing the work need someone who turns priorities into plans, keeps the work moving, and makes sure nothing falls between the cracks.



Mission



Make marketing ship. The Head of GTM sets the strategy and owns the budget. The channel specialists own the craft. You are the operational backbone — you turn strategy into project plans, run the delivery cadence, and unblock specialists so their work lands on time and on scope. Specialists hit their numbers because you're behind the scenes making it happen.



What you'll own



- Project planning. Translate the Head of GTM's priorities into clear plans — milestones, dependencies, owners, deadlines. One plan per major initiative (Google Ads scale, SEO foundation, Reddit launch, etc.). The Head of GTM guides and supports you through this — you're not planning alone.

- Task tracking. Every project broken into trackable tasks in our PM tool (Asana/Notion). Status is always current. Nothing lives only in your head.

- Specialist support. Daily or weekly check-ins with each specialist (depending on the project phase). What do you need? What's blocking you? What's the next deliverable? You unblock first, escalate only when you can't resolve it.

- Cross-specialist coordination. When the SEO specialist needs a tracking event from the Tracking specialist, you connect them. You see the full board; each specialist sees only their lane.

- Cadence. You run a weekly review with all specialists + Head of GTM. Sharp, fast: status, blockers, decisions needed. No theatre.

- Documentation. Decisions, deliverables, dependencies, what worked, what didn't. You build the operating system, not a memory.



KPIs you'll be measured on

- % of projects delivered on time. Did we ship what we said, when we said?

- Time-to-unblock. When a specialist flags a blocker, how fast does it resolve? Most should clear within 48 hours.

- Specialist clarity. Do specialists always know what they're working on, what's next, and what they're waiting on? Measured by a quick weekly pulse (1–5).

- Head of GTM visibility. Zero surprises. The Head of GTM should never have to ask 'what's happening with [project]?' — the answer is already in the dashboard.



Profile — must-haves

- 3+ years in project / program / delivery management — ideally in marketing, growth, or creative ops. Other domains OK if the operating cadence was similar (multiple parallel workstreams, external specialists, weekly delivery).

- Fluent in at least one PM tool (Asana, Notion, etc.). You've built project boards from scratch, not just used templates.

- Comfortable being the most organized person in the room that has marketing experience, NOT the most expert. You ask great questions; you don't pretend to have answers you don't have.

- Strong written communication — most of this job is written briefs, status updates, and decision logs.

- Calm under deadline pressure. Specialists will miss things; you don't panic, you re-plan.

- Comfortable working async with a small remote team across time zones.



Profile — nice-to-haves

- Past work coordinating paid acquisition, SEO, content, or community-led marketing — as the coordinator, not the expert.

- Experience working with freelancers / external contractors (most of our specialists are project-based).

title: SEO Expert Wanted — Commission plus a small Salary — £350 Per Converted Lead
description:
True SEO Expert Wanted — Commission of  £350 Per Converted Job plus a small salary of £100 per month.



Please read this carefully before applying. This role is not for everyone, and I want to be upfront so we don't waste each other's time.



About Us

We are a property maintenance and renovation company based in Central London, serving high-end residential and commercial clients. Our website has excellent, well-written content, but it currently generates almost no traffic/ leads — roughly one lead every two months. Our internal sales conversion rate is 40%, so the bottleneck is purely SEO and lead generation, not closing.



The Honest Background

I have hired two SEO specialists before. Both took my money and delivered very little. One blamed Google's algorithm. The other blamed AI. I am no longer interested in excuses. I am looking for someone who takes full ownership of results.



What We're Offering

This is a commission-only arrangement. You will be paid £350 for every bathroom renovation lead that converts into a paid job in our Central London service area.



If you can deliver around 9 quality leads per month, we expect to convert at least 3 of them. That's £1,050+ per month, with significant upside as rankings improve. There is no cap.



Who I Want to Hear From

- Proven track record in difficult, service-based niches — trades, contractors, bathroom renovations, kitchen renovations, plumbing, electrical, or similar

- Fully independent on both on-page and off-page SEO (technical audits, content optimisation, link building, local SEO, GBP, schema, the lot)

- Confident you can move the needle within 3–6 months

- Strictly white-hat only



Who I Don't Want

- Anyone who blames Google updates, AI, or anything else for poor results

- Anyone who uses PBNs, link farms, cloaking, or any black-hat tactics — you will be dismissed immediately and without payment

- Agencies trying to disguise themselves as freelancers

- Anyone who needs hand-holding or a monthly retainer to feel motivated



How to Apply

Do not send a generic pitch. In your message, please include:

1. Two or three case studies from service-based or trades businesses — domain, before/after rankings, and the niche

2. The exact keywords you ranked them for and the geographic area

3. Your honest assessment of how long it took

4. Your proposed first 30, 60, and 90-day actions for a London-based bathroom renovation website



If you cannot provide real, verifiable examples, please do not apply.



This is built on trust and results. If you're confident in your ability, the earning potential here is genuine and uncapped. If you're not, this role isn't for you — and that's fine.



Looking forward to hearing from the right person.

title: Head of Paid Search & YouTube -  $5,000 USD/Month + Performance Bonus + Benefits
description:
How to Apply? Kindly fill out the application form:



About Us

We are the Golden Horde, an e-commerce company in the pain relief space. We did $10M+ in 2025 and we're on track to hit $25M in 2026. We're scaling hard this year — and Google + YouTube is the channel we're betting our trajectory on.

The Role



We need someone to own Google and YouTube end-to-end. Right now, no one does. The account spends ~$90K/month, and every week it sits without a driver is a week we're not scaling.

This is the seat where the channel lives or dies. You set the strategy, run the buying, brief the creative team on what's working, and report directly to the CEO. 



We don't have a spend cap. We have a profit floor. If you can find another $50K/month at target ROAS, we will fund it. Your job is to scale spend as aggressively as profit allows — without breaking ROAS.



What You'll Do



Campaign Management & Scaling

Launch and manage Google Search, PMax, Shopping, and YouTube campaigns 

Own the ~$90K/month current spend and build the plan to scale it past $200K/month profitably

Build audience structures, bidding strategies, and YouTube creative testing frameworks

Navigate Google's health & wellness ad policies — handle disapprovals, compliance rewrites, and landing page fixes without losing days to back-and-forth



Creative Feedback Loop (YouTube)

Brief the creative team on what's winning — angles, hooks, CTAs, pacing

When ads get disapproved, diagnose why and tell the creative team exactly what to change: script, visual, or claim language

Close the loop fast: disapproval to fixed version live in 48 hours



Analysis & Optimization

Pull daily performance data from Google Ads, GA4, and attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar)

Identify winners, kill losers fast

Written weekly review: ROAS, CPA, CTR, spend pacing, and the decisions behind them



Communication & Ownership

Daily Slack EOD: what you built today, what changed in the accounts, what the data is telling you, and your call on what's next

Weekly 1:1 with the CEO — come with recommendations, not asks

Flag account issues (disapprovals, policy flags, billing problems) within 1 hour of discovery

Bring a scale thesis on day 1, refine it by day 7. We don't need an auditor. We need an operator.



What We're Looking For

Proof of work first. You've personally managed Google Ads accounts at $100K+/month for at least 12 months. In the technical interview, you'll walk us through a live account you've actually scaled — campaign structure, change history, ROAS trend, the decisions you made.

Scale, not maintenance. You've taken an account from X to 2X or 3X in spend while holding ROAS. If you've only ever maintained what someone else built, this isn't the role.

YouTube ads — non-negotiable. You've built and scaled YouTube campaigns, not just Search and PMax. Show us the accounts.

Creative direction confidence. You can brief a video team on what to change about a hook, a script, or a claim — not just "make a new ad."

DTC e-commerce experience. Health, wellness, fitness, recovery, or pain relief background preferred. You know how Google evaluates health-vertical landing pages.

Fluent across the Google stack: Google Ads Manager, GA4, Google Merchant Center, Google Tag Manager, YouTube Studio.

Attribution literacy. You've used Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar — and you can explain why last-click is a lie.

You overcommunicate. You send updates before being asked. If something breaks, the team hears about it from you first — not from the dashboard.

Strong written and spoken English. You'll be on camera with the CEO weekly.

Stable internet and backup power. Non-negotiable for managing $90K+/month in live spend.



Nice-to-Have: Microsoft Ads (Bing)

If you know Microsoft Ads, you'll mirror our Google campaigns onto Bing with a budget we'll agree on

Not required to apply, but a bonus if you can show Bing accounts you've built



Compensation & Benefits

$5,000 USD/month base salary

Performance bonus tied to ROAS and spend-scale milestones — activates after successful 3-month probation

Flexible hours (weekly CEO overlap required)

Paid holidays

Paid VL and SL



Closing

If you can look at a $90K Google + YouTube account in the pain relief space and already see where the next $100K of profitable spend is hiding, we want to talk.

description:
Salt is a Brisbane-based digital marketing agency. We build websites and run growth campaigns for a range of B2B clients — trade, industrial, construction, professional services. We have high standards for design and we're looking for someone who does too. If you find yourself bookmarking Awwwwards for inspiration on a Tuesday afternoon, keep reading.



The role



You'll work alongside our web team to design responsive websites for our client portfolio. Your job starts with a client's existing site, a creative brief from our strategists, and a mandate to make something better — something that feels like us, feels like them, and actually converts.



This is a design role with real creative latitude. We're not after someone to implement pre-approved wireframes. We want someone who looks at a brief and an old website and knows immediately what the story should be — and how to tell it visually.



Key responsibilities



Design full-page mockups and homepage concepts in Figma — from initial concept through to handoff-ready specs

Audit client websites and creative briefs, and translate that context into design that reinforces brand messaging and tells a compelling story

Design for WordPress (Elementor) and Shopify — understanding the constraints and possibilities of each platform

Balance aesthetic ambition with conversion-focused layout — every design needs to look world-class and generate leads

Work efficiently — our current designers deliver polished homepage demos or landing pages within 4–6 hours. Speed and quality are not a trade-off here.

Collaborate with our web developers and strategists to ensure the final build matches the design intent

Who we're looking for



A designer with strong instincts for visual storytelling — you understand how layout, hierarchy, and imagery guide a visitor through a brand's narrative

Highly proficient in Figma with a portfolio that demonstrates responsive web design across a range of industries

Experience designing for B2B clients — you understand how to make a trades company, an industrial brand, or a professional services firm look premium without losing trust

Confident working from a brief — able to read between the lines and produce something that makes a client feel genuinely understood

Fast and decisive — you don't need ten rounds of internal revision to land on something great

Elementor build experience is a significant advantage — designers who can also build what they design move fast with us

A portfolio is non-negotiable — applications without one will not be considered

The standard we design to



We build websites our clients are genuinely proud of — sites that would hold their own as Awwwwards inspiration, while being grounded in conversion strategy. If your portfolio has work you'd hesitate to share, this probably isn't the right fit. If it has work you're proud to show, we want to see it.

Rotate the 3 core pain angles weekly — never repeat the same angle two weeks running: (1) skinny fat / effort gap, (2) program hopping / lost plan, (3) glute plateau / nutrition chaos

title: AI Vibe Coder / Agentic Engineer
description:
What we do



We run a venture studio building multiple operating ventures (web platforms, AI products, internal tools). We're building an ecosystem of AI agents from scratch, Claude, Codex, Cursor, MCP servers, custom pipelines, to design, build, ship, and maintain these ventures. We need someone who can plug into that ecosystem and become an operator inside it.



What is a "vibe coder"?



It is someone who builds working software by directing AI tools instead of typing every line by hand. You describe what you want, you read what the AI produces, you test it, you push back when it is wrong, you ship it. You do not need a CS degree but developers are a bonus***. You need taste, judgment, and the ability to learn fast.



What you will actually do**



- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to build and ship features across our ventures

- Orchestrate AI agents to run repeatable workflows (research, code review, content, deployment)

- Read code carefully enough to know when the AI is lying to you

- Run tests, fix bugs, deploy to Vercel / similar platforms

- Document what you build so the next AI session can pick up where you left off

- Work directly with the founder on whatever venture is hot that week



**Who we are looking for**



- Obsessed with AI tools,  you already use ChatGPT or Claude daily for non-trivial work

- Can read JavaScript, Python, or TypeScript well enough to debug — you do not need to write it from scratch

- Comfortable in a terminal (git, npm, basic bash)

- Fast learner, when you hit something new, you figure it out in hours, not weeks

- Written English strong enough to write clear prompts and clear documentation

- Honest about what you do not know



**Bonus (not required)**



- Experience with Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, or similar modern web stacks

- Have shipped something, anything, built with AI assistance (show us)

- Familiar with MCP, agent frameworks, or n8n / Zapier-style orchestration



**How to apply**



Do not send a generic cover letter. Send:



1. A link to one thing you built with AI help (even small — a script, a site, a Chrome extension)

2. A 3-5 sentence description of how you used AI to build it and what went wrong

3. Your favorite AI tool right now and why

4. The phrase "good vibes" in your application headline so we know you read this far



Applications without these will be ignored.



*We are building a long-term home for the right person. If you are looking for a stable, intellectually demanding role where you learn the cutting edge of AI engineering on the job, apply.*

title: Social Media & Content Producer
description:
About Hair Clubs

Hair Clubs is a B2B SaaS loyalty platform that helps ambitious salon owners retain clients and grow their business without doing any marketing — by turning their clients into the marketing team. We’re building a brand that looks and feels like nothing else in the hair industry. Think run club meets hair. The creative bar is high. The pace is fast. 



The Role

You are the person who can drive content ideas, structure it into a calendar rhythm and turn it into a published, designed, edited, captioned post — without needing three people in the middle. Right now our content pipeline has too many handoffs. We need one person who can collapse that chain for the daily output.



You’re not replacing our Art Director. She sets the brand world, leads campaigns, and produces the high-end creative. You’re the daily engine — the person who keeps the grid alive, the stories running, the comments answered, and the content flowing without bottlenecking anyone else on the team. 





The most important thing: you think about what happens after you post. Every post exists to create a response, and when that response comes, someone needs to be on the other end. That someone is you. Additionally, you think of how we capture people’s information from socials and move it into our database and you’re not afraid to ask the engineers to build an automation to do that.



Content Production (60%)

 • Design social assets in Photoshop — tiles, carousels, EDM graphics, cover tiles, thumbnails

 • Edit short-form video for Reels, Stories, and TikTok (CapCut, Premiere, or DaVinci)

 • Create reel cover tiles independently without needing the Art Director for every post

 • Build and maintain reusable templates for recurring content formats

 • Produce EDM creative (graphic design)

 • Repurpose long-form content (podcast episodes) into short-form clips

 • Work with the Art Director on brand-level creative when needed, but own the daily output independently

 • create copy 



Social Media Management (40%)

 • Own the Hair Clubs, YSS and CWGL  Instagram end-to-end — ideation, creation, posting, engagement

 • Write captions and CTAs that connect into the customer journey

 • Respond to every comment and DM same-day

 • Run Instagram Stories and maintain Highlights

 • Manage the Hair Clubs broadcast channel

 • Schedule and repost existing show content to secondary channels

 • Default to collaboration on all tagged/co-created content

 • Drop a weekly social media report every Friday



Required Tools & Skills

 • Adobe Photoshop — intermediate (layers, masks, text, export for web, template adaptation)

 • Video Editing (CapCut / Premiere / DaVinci) — intermediate (cuts, transitions, text overlays, audio sync, vertical format)

 • Claude — you already use AI in your workflow 

 • Instagram / Meta Business Suite — confident (scheduling, insights, collab posts, stories, highlights)

 • Slack, Notion, Google Workspace — working proficiency



You’ll Thrive Here If

 • You’ve run a brand’s Instagram end-to-end and can show growth, engagement, and creative range

 • Your portfolio shows design and video work, not just strategy decks

 • You’re the kind of person who sees a competitor’s post and immediately thinks “we should do our version of that”

 • You can take a 45-minute podcast and turn it into 5 reels without being given timestamps

 • You treat every post like it’s a conversation starter, not a checkbox

 • You’re comfortable working in a small, fast team where everyone sees everything





Salary negotiable





Take a look at our instagram for creative

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Hair Clubs (6-month contract)

Remote · Philippines-based · Full-time hours · 6-month contract with extension potential



What Hair Clubs is

We help ambitious salon owners retain clients and grow their business without doing any marketing — by turning their clients into the marketing team.



Members post, tag, earn rewards, move through tiers, get mystery boxes. Salons stay behind the chair. The platform does the rest.



We're scaling with strong retention metrics, deep in a campaign and partnership phase, and the product needs to catch up to where the brand and demand already are.



That's where you come in.







The role

You'll own a 6-month build that lands three things — all of them sitting on a foundation of clean data and predictive intelligence:



Complete the member-facing app interface — finishing the front-end so members move through the experience the way the brand promises. Every interaction tracked, every event clean, every state queryable.

Automate onboarding from signup to first reward — building a tutorial and activation sequence that removes human friction. Tracked learning at every step (where do salons stall, where do members drop), AI assistance that predicts what a customer needs before they reach out — surfacing the answer, the next action, or the nudge in-product rather than in our inbox.

Meta middleware with data integrity at the core — webhook architecture replacing third-party dependencies (story mentions, tags, conversions). Built so the data is trustworthy end-to-end: no silent failures, no missed events, no reconciliation nightmares. 







Underneath all three: a platform where data integrity is non-negotiable, instrumentation is built in, and AI is a first-class layer — not a feature, but how the product anticipates the user.







Alongside that: prep the platform for scale, document the system, train the team, and contribute to a separate client-facing platform (roughly 60/40 split — Hair Clubs primary, client platform secondary).



Stack

Next.js / React front-end

Postgres, edge functions, auth

Node back-end

Meta Graph API, webhooks, n8n, AWS

What you need to have shipped

Production Next.js + Supabase at real scale 

Built and operated webhook systems and Meta Graph API integrations

Scalable backend architecture with a genuine security focus

CI/CD and TDD as defaults

AI-native workflow — agents are part of how you work





How you work

Self-directed. 

Async-first written communication. 

You care about the data. Every feature ships with a way to measure whether it's doing its job.

The team

A small, very technical team working in agile sprints. You'd be working directly with the Founder & CTO on architecture and product direction, alongside an Ops & Automation engineer handling internal systems and integrations, plus the wider YSS team covering brand, content, and creative around the product. High-context, no middle management — decisions happen fast and you're close to all of them.







Process

Apply with a short note + portfolio / GitHub / shipped work

Technical interview

Code review of something you've built

Offer

title: Customer Service - Technology Support Virtual Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a generic admin role. You'll be joining a specialist technology company as their first dedicated support and client success virtual tea
mber — and your work will directly protect the capacity of a high-performing senior technical team.



The business manages a national portfolio of technology installations across hundreds of facilities. The team is excellent at what they do, but right now there's no structured triage layer — which means experienced technicians are spending time on problems that don't need them. That's where you come in.



You'll start on Tier 1 support and health checks, learn the platforms and the client base through structured shadowing, and build into a genuine client success function over time. 



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Tier 1 Support & Ticket Triage

Monitor the helpdesk and triage incoming support tickets by urgency and complexity

Resolve Tier 1 issues independently using documented troubleshooting processes

Escalate complex issues to senior technicians with full context — what was attempted, what was found

Answer inbound support calls, provide first-line assistance, and transfer where needed

Log all ticket activity, resolution notes, and client communications clearly

Flag recurring issue patterns for SOP documentation



Proactive Client Health Checks

Work through structured health check checklists via remote access (TeamViewer)

Cover: database backups, open-door reports, CCTV/camera status, hard drive health, UPS status, alarm zone testing, and comms checks

Record all findings and flag issues for follow-up

Track health check schedules to ensure no client goes overdue

Run opportunistic health checks when already connected to a client system



Post-Resolution Follow-Up & Client Success

Contact clients 3–7 days after ticket resolution to confirm the fix held and they're satisfied

Offer health checks during follow-up calls where relevant

Assist clients to complete satisfaction surveys during the call

Gather intelligence on future plans (new sites, upgrades, expansion) and log for the senior team

Build rapport so clients experience the business as a proactive partner, not just a break-fix service



Documentation & SOP Management

Document processes in real time as you learn them during shadowing

Present SOPs back to the relevant tea
mber for sign-off before finalising

Maintain and update SOPs as processes evolve

Contribute to the internal knowledge base by uploading training transcripts, recordings, and tech manuals



Daily Communication & Reporting

Send a morning priorities message via WhatsApp to the team at the start of each day

Send an end-of-day report covering: completed tasks, work in progress, and items requiring attention

Communicate in real time with the technical team via Google Chat throughout the day



Operational Flexibility

During high-volume periods (storms, outages, major updates), assist with bulk client communication and additional ticket load

Switch between health checks and inbound tickets based on workload — without needing to be directed for each pivot

Assist with new site onboarding into systems and software during expansion phases



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who is first and foremost a warm, confident communicator with a genuine service orientation. Technical aptitude matters — but character matters more.

?  Read carefully. This role requires a specific skill set and mindset. If you're the right fit, you'll know it immediately.

__________________________________



THE ROLE

You will edit talking head and faceless educational videos using CapCut desktop (paid/Pro version required). You will follow a specific workflow that has been developed and refined for this business. You will QA your own work during editing — not after — and submit clean videos that do not require correction.



You will also handle supporting admin tasks once video editing is mastered.

•  Follow a precise 3-step workflow: cut audio ? sync video ? QA simultaneously during editing

•  Extract audio from video clips and manage audio/video tracks separately on the timeline

•  Remove mistakes, pauses, breaths, and dead air with clean, undetectable cuts

•  Ensure no words are cut off — every word must complete fully before a cut

•  Eliminate all screen jumps — mouse movement must be natural and continuous across every clip transition

•  Ensure all audio clips are directly adjacent on the timeline — no gaps

•  QA during editing, not after — you should know your video is clean before you submit it

•  Complete a full QA checklist before every submission

•  Target turnaround: 20-minute video edited and submitted within 4 hours

•  Add end screens, CTAs, captions, thumbnails, and descriptions for YouTube and TikTok

* Add graphics, text, pop-ups and motion graphics on video

________________________________
