title: Analytical VA — Video Editing + Admin Support
description:
Detail-Driven Analytical VA

Video Production + Admin + Graphics

Remote  |  Philippines-based  |  Full-Time  |  EST Hours



Before you read the task list, read this first.



We are not looking for someone with the longest resume or the most software certifications. We are looking for a specific type of person.



You catch things other people miss.

You follow a process exactly as given — you don't improvise or substitute your own method.

When you finish a task, you review it before anyone asks you to.

You take detailed notes the first time something is taught so you don't need it repeated.

When you hit a problem, you think through it before asking for help.

You take ownership of your output — errors in your work are your responsibility to catch, not your employer's.



If that description sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, this role will be frustrating for both of us.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing YouTube-based content business producing talking head and faceless educational videos. This is an operations support role — you will help keep the content engine running cleanly and efficiently.



The role has three areas. They are listed in order of priority:



•  Video editing — this is the core of the role and where your attention to detail matters most

•  Admin and operations support

•  Graphics and visual content



You do not need to be an expert in all three from day one. You need to have the right mindset and be trainable. The workflow for video editing will be taught to you in full. What cannot be taught is the ability to follow it precisely and catch your own mistakes.



VIDEO EDITING — PRIMARY FOCUS

?  This is the most important part of the role. Everything else is secondary to this.

You will edit talking head and faceless YouTube videos using CapCut desktop (Pro version required). You will be trained on a specific 3-step workflow. Your job is to learn it, apply it exactly, and deliver clean videos that do not need correction.



What that looks like in practice:

•  Cut audio, sync video, and QA simultaneously — not separately, not after

•  No words cut off mid-syllable — every word completes fully before a cut

•  No screen jumps — mouse movement must be natural and continuous across every clip

•  No audio gaps — all clips butted directly together on the timeline

•  Audio extracted and managed separately from the video track

•  Complete a QA checklist before every submission — no exceptions

•  Target turnaround: 20-minute video edited and submitted within 4 hours once trained



You do not need years of editing experience. You need CapCut desktop familiarity, a trained eye for detail, and the ability to absorb and apply a workflow the first time it is shown to you.



ADMIN & OPERATIONS SUPPORT

•  Social media research and engagement using provided SOPs

•  Community management — comments, conversation starters, engagement

•  Manage and track tasks in Asana and Slack

•  Update sales systems, lead tracking, and website content as needed

•  Data entry, spreadsheet tracking, and document management

•  Daily and weekly reporting



GRAPHICS & VISUAL CONTENT

•  Create thumbnails and social media graphics using Canva

•  Maintain consistency with brand templates and visual standards

•  Design basic promotional and content visuals as directed



WHO YOU ARE

The best candidates for this role have come from backgrounds that demanded precision — not just creativity. If your prior work required you to get things exactly right with no room for error, you'll fit here.



Backgrounds that translate well:

•  QA or compliance

•  Medical billing or insurance operations

•  Data entry auditing or claims processing

•  Paralegal or legal support

•  Finance, payroll, or bookkeeping

•  Social media management with a strong analytical component

•  Any role where following a system exactly was non-negotiable



You also need:

•  CapCut desktop — Pro/paid version — installed before your start date

•  Availability EST hours — training is 6–9 PM EST, flexible after probation

•  Strong English communication — written and verbal

•  Experience with Asana, Notion, ClickUp, or similar tools

•  Canva experience — thumbnails and basic graphics

•  Reliable internet and a working laptop capable of running CapCut desktop



NON-NEGOTIABLES

If you cannot commit to all of the following, do not apply.

•  CapCut desktop Pro installed and confirmed before start date

•  Available EST hours for training and regular check-ins

•  Follows the taught workflow exactly — no substituting your own methods

•  Takes detailed notes during training — does not ask the same question twice

•  Submits a completed QA checklist with every video

•  Does not submit work with obvious errors — you catch your own mistakes before handoff

•  Able to complete a 20-minute video edit within 4 hours once trained and independent



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

•  $3–5 USD/hour based on experience and performance ($2.50 per hour for training)

•  Paid weekly

•  13th-month pay

•  Monthly performance bonuses for exceeding KPIs

•  Annual retention bonus review

•  Performance-based raises

•  Promotion path — top performers can grow into team lead and management roles

•  Ongoing skill development — AI tools, social media, writing, video editing, and more

•  Stable, long-term employment with clear SOPs, systems, and feedback



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW EVERY STEP



Attention to detail starts with how you apply. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line:

"Applying To – Analytical VA – [Your Name]"



Include ALL of the following in your
, in this exact order:



1. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

2. Resume as a PDF

3. A 1–2 minute intro video: tell us who you are, your relevant background, and why your attention to detail makes you the right fit for this role specifically

4. A video editing sample — a talking head or faceless video you have edited. No sample = no consideration

5. Confirm you have CapCut desktop Pro installed and ready to use

6. Confirm you are available to work EST hours

7. Write the word FALCON at the end of your
 to confirm you read this posting in full

title: Google Ads Manager - eCommerce $2500/month
description:
Google Ads Manager (Google + YouTube) — $2,500 USD/Month + Performance Bonus

Remote | Full-Time | 30 Paid Leaves | Flexible Sched



About Us

We are the Golden Horde, an e-commerce company with 2 brands generating $10M+ in yearly revenue in the pain relief and health & wellness space. We're scaling hard in 2026 — and Google + YouTube is the channel we're betting on next.



The Role

We're looking for a Google Ads Manager who lives inside Google Ads and YouTube Studio. You'll own $40K+/month in ad spend across both brands — and we want you to scale it. This is not a maintenance seat. We're hiring you to grow the account, not babysit it.



You'll work directly with the CEO and the creative team. Your job: keep the account compliant, keep ROAS profitable, and push spend up and to the right without breaking it.



What You'll Do

Campaign Management & Scaling

-Launch and manage Google Search, PMax, Shopping, and YouTube campaigns across 2 brands in Google Ads

-Own $40K+/month in spend today — and drive the strategy to scale it meaningfully over the coming quarters

-Build audience structures, bidding strategies, and creative testing frameworks for YouTube video ads

-Navigate YouTube ad approvals for health & wellness / pain relief claims — handle

disapprovals, compliance rewrites, and landing page adjustments without needing your hand held



Analysis & Optimization

-Pull daily performance data from Google Ads, GA4, and attribution tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar)

-Identify winners, kill losers fast — no campaign runs untouched for 72 hours

-Report on ROAS, CPA, CTR, and ad spend vs. target weekly



Communication & Collaboration

-Brief the creative team on what's working in YouTube ads — angles, hooks, CTAs, pacing

-Send a written daily update to Slack: spend, ROAS, key decisions, and what you need from the team

-Flag account issues (disapprovals, policy flags, billing problems) within 1 hour of discovery

-Weekly call with the CEO to review performance and next moves



Nice-to-Have: 

-Microsoft Ads (Bing)

-If you know Microsoft Ads, you'll also run our Bing campaigns on the side — mirrored from Google, with budget we'll agree on

-Not a requirement to apply, but a strong bonus if you can show Bing accounts you've built before



What We're Looking For

-Proof of work first. You've personally managed Google Ads accounts at $30K+/month in spend for at least 2 years. You can show screenshots of account spend, ROAS, and campaign structure in the interview.

-Scale, not just maintenance. You've taken an account from X to 2X or 3X in spend while holding ROAS. If you've only ever maintained what someone else built, this isn't the role for you.

-YouTube video ads experience — non-negotiable. You've built and scaled YouTube ad campaigns, not just Search and PMax. Show us the accounts.

-Health & wellness / supplements / pain relief experience. You've successfully gotten

YouTube video ads approved in restricted categories. You know the difference between what Google flags and what it lets through.

-Fluent in the Google Ads stack: Google Ads Manager, GA4, Google Merchant Center, Google Tag Manager, YouTube Studio

-Attribution literacy: You've used Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar and can explain why last-click is a lie

-You overcommunicate. You send updates before being asked. If something breaks, the team hears about it from you first — not from the dashboard.

-Strong written and spoken English. You'll be on camera with the CEO weekly.

-Stable internet and backup power. Non-negotiable for a role that manages $40K/month in live spend.



Bonus points:

-Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience — you've built and scaled Bing accounts alongside Google

-Experience with health supplement landing page compliance (FDA disclaimers, claim language)

-Background running ads for DTC e-commerce brands at $10M+ in revenue



Benefits

-Flexible hours

-Paid holidays

-Paid sick days

-Performance bonus tied to ad spend scale and ROAS targets (structure finalized on hire)



If you can look at a $40K Google + YouTube account in the pain relief niche and already see where the growth is hiding, we want to talk.

 or
 your Updated CV to 
 with a subject line: Google Ads Manager - [Total years of experience as a Google Ads Manager in Ecommerce]

- To be part of a multinational team that cares about you, and be part of a team not just staff

• Help turn raw ideas into powerful, viral-ready videos

• Bring your own suggestions, creativity, and marketing mind to every project







What Makes This Role Unique:

• You will help grow a fast-scaling brand with huge global potential

• Long-term, stable, career-building opportunity

• You will have the freedom to grow, lead, and experiment creatively

• Exposure to different niches, products, and video styles

• Opportunities to travel with the team as operations expand in couple of months from now



This is a job for someone who wants to build a real career, not just “edit videos.”







Ideal Candidate Profile

• Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills

• Deep understanding of TikTok/Reels/Shorts virality

• Fast, efficient, and consistent daily editor

• Creative thinker with marketing instincts

• Problem solver who can work with limited footage

• Team player with great communication

• Long-term mindset with the ambition to grow inside the company

• Able to take feedback and improve quickly

?

This is an exciting, high-growth opportunity for a dedicated editor who wants to rise, earn more, and build a powerful career inside a fast-growing company.

title: Social Media Strategist/Executive Assistant
description:
Here is the full job post ready to copy and paste:



Social Media Strategist / Executive Assistant

Full Time | 40 Hours Per Week | 8:00am – 5:00pm CST (Graveyard Shift)

$5–$7 per hour based on experience



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING

This role requires you to work 8:00am to 5:00pm Central Standard Time, Monday through Friday. This is a graveyard shift for candidates in certain time zones. Do not apply if this schedule is not something you can commit to fully and consistently. This is a non-negotiable requirement of the role and will be confirmed during the interview process.



WHO WE ARE

Keenya Kelly LLC is a fast-growing social media education and digital course company based in Houston, Texas. Our founder, Keenya Kelly, has built a 600,000+ following across TikTok and Instagram, generated $4M+ in revenue through strategic short vertical video content, and helped over 10,000 entrepreneurs grow their audiences and turn their content into consistent income.



We are a small, high-performing team that moves fast, operates inside clear systems, and holds a high standard for everything we put into the market. We are looking for someone who matches that energy.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist and Executive Assistant who is equal parts strategic thinker and reliable executor. This is not a role for someone who only wants to manage a content calendar. This is a role for someone who understands social media at a strategic level, can research and analyze what is working in the market, translate that research into content ideas rooted in our brand voice, and support the day-to-day operations that keep the business running.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in social media strategy, is deeply familiar with TikTok and Instagram, understands how content funnels work, and can think critically about why content performs — not just what to post. They are also highly organized, proactive with communication, and thrive inside structured systems.



If you are someone who has worked with online educators, course creators, or personal brands and you understand how content drives revenue, this role was written for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Social Media Strategy:

Research competitors and market trends weekly and report findings with strategic insights — not just observations but clear notes on what is working, why it is working, and how we can apply it to our brand

Develop content ideas rooted in our brand voice, content pillars, and existing strategy document

Submit content ideas for approval with clear notes on the hook, the teaching point, the funnel connection, and the keyword trigger being used

Study our existing content library deeply so that every idea you bring is grounded in our founder's voice and insights

Monitor platform trends on TikTok, Instagram, and
 and flag relevant opportunities

Track content performance and report weekly on what is working and what needs to be adjusted

Support the development of our content operating system including our hook library, proof library, caption formulas, and CTA library



Executive Assistant Support:

Manage and organize the founder's task list and priorities daily

Draft communications, documents, and internal resources as directed

Keep project management systems updated and accurate in Notion

Coordinate between tea
mbers to keep workflows moving

Attend tea
etings, take notes, and follow up on action items

Support launch operations including content scheduling,
 coordination, and campaign logistics

Handle additional administrative tasks as assigned



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a role where you will work independently without direction and deliver results once a week. We operate with daily check-ins, end of day summaries, and prompt responses to tea
ssages during working hours. Communication and accountability are non-negotiable parts of this role.



This is also not a role where you will create content from your own ideas without grounding them in our brand. Every content idea must connect back to our founder's voice, our strategy, and our existing offer ecosystem.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience in social media strategy, preferably with personal brands, online educators, or course creators

Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram and how content drives audience growth and revenue

Experience researching competitors and translating findings into actionable strategy

Excellent written English — you will be writing content ideas, captions, and communications daily

Highly organized with strong attention to detail

Reliable, proactive, and consistent with communication

Able to work 8:00am to 5:00pm CST Monday through Friday without exception

Proficiency in the following tools is required: GoHighLevel (GHL), ManyChat, Canva, ChatGPT, and Notion

Bonus if you also have experience with Claude AI



HOW WE WORK

We operate inside clear systems and documented processes. You will be given a detailed strategy document, brand voice guide, and content operating system to work from. You will not be guessing. You will be expected to learn our systems quickly, ask questions when you need clarity, and execute with precision once direction has been given.

We give feedback consistently and we invest in the growth of our tea
mbers. In return we expect full commitment, honest communication, and a standard of work that reflects the brand we are building.



COMPENSATION

$5–$7 per hour based on experience, paid weekly. This is a full time role at 40 hours per week.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role you must complete the following steps. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

Step 1: Send your application with the subject line: Social Media Strategist Application — 

Step 2: In your application include the following:

A brief introduction telling us who you are and why you are the right fit for this role

Your resume or work history with relevant experience highlighted

Two to three examples of social media strategy work you have done — this can include content calendars, competitor research reports, content ideas you developed, or campaigns you supported

Your answer to this question in writing: "This role requires working 8:00am to 5:00pm CST Monday through Friday. Confirm that you can commit to this schedule consistently and explain how you will manage it."

Your answer to this question in writing: "Walk us through how you would take a piece of content from a competitor and use it to develop an original content idea for a different brand."

Applications that do not answer both questions will not be considered.

title: Director of Social Media & Content Distribution | Competitive Pay + Monthly Bonuses | 100% Remote
description:
What We Offer

- Competitive base salary plus monthly KPI-linked bonuses (roughly 25% of total earnings)

- Direct line to the CPO — you report into the executive team, not through it

- A senior seat in a company growing fast enough that the scope of your role expands meaningfully every quarter

- Ownership of the distribution function end-to-end: infrastructure, compliance, team, and headcount decisions

- Daily AI tooling and a team that uses it seriously

- 100% remote, hiring in South Africa and the Philippines



COMPENSATION

Base Pay - $1,500 – $2,000 / month USD

KPI bonus - $500 – $667 / month USD

OTE - $2,000 – $2,667 / month USD



The Role

Most distribution roles hand you a machine and ask you to keep it running. This one hands you two working departments, a half-built scheduling system, two empty org charts, and an 18-month runway to 4× the operation.



You'll inherit Meta/TikTok and Reddit on day one — roughly 17 people already shipping content. In June, you'll hire a YouTube Director and launch that department from scratch. In August, you'll do the same for
. By the start of 2027, you'll be running distribution for 87 creators across four platforms with a team of 30+. The infrastructure you build in your first six months will carry the agency through the biggest growth phase in its history.



This is the role for someone who reads "build it from zero" and feels their pulse go up — not down. We're a creator management agency in a high-velocity niche, and we're moving fast enough that the scope of this seat will be unrecognizable a year in.



The First 90 Days

- Day 30: AutoPoster fully migrated and live across all Meta and TikTok accounts. Relationships established with your two existing department heads. First weekly report to the CPO delivered.

- Day 60: YouTube Director hired and onboarded. Distribution dashboard live with engagement, volume, and compliance visible in one view.

- Day 90: YouTube Phase 1 posting.
 Manager spec written and recruitment opened.



What We're Looking For

- 5+ years in senior multi-platform social media operations, ideally agency-side, with a proven record of growing traffic, reach, and revenue across managed accounts.

- You've launched a platform team from zero before — YouTube or
 from scratch is directly relevant.

- You've managed managers and held senior operators to standards without becoming their peer.

- You've owned a violations or compliance feedback loop — catching issues is table stakes; diagnosing the upstream cause and closing it is what we're hiring for.

- You think critically across platforms. You can walk into a novel compliance situation that's not in the playbook and make a defensible call from first principles.

- You're operationally fluent with scheduling and autoposter tooling.

- You use AI tools daily.

- You're comfortable directing distribution for adult-adjacent creator content.



Location & Hours

We're hiring in South Africa and the Philippines. 100% remote. Daily working hours start at 7:00am SAST (South Africa) or align with GMT+8 (Philippines) for team overlap. Strong global candidates considered where overlap is equivalent or better.



Hiring Process

We hire quickly. Applications open Friday — first interviews the following week, final decisions within roughly three weeks.

title: Creator outreach specialist — do you know how to start a real conversation online?
description:
This isn't a posting for someone who sends copy-paste DMs all day and calls it outreach. We're looking for someone who actually gets social media — someone who reads the room, adapts their approach, and knows what it takes to make a stranger want to respond.





*What this job actually is*

We're a fast-growing eCommerce company that works with online content creators. Your job is to get their attention and turn that attention into a real business conversation. That's it. Simple concept — genuinely hard to do well.



We have a CRM stocked with creators ready to be contacted. On any given day you'll be working through that list across X, Instagram, Reddit, and other platforms — writing personalized outreach, managing follow-ups, keeping CRM data accurate, and constantly testing new angles when the current ones stop converting. When something isn't working, you don't wait to be told. You try something new.





*Who we are looking for*

- Self-starters who move without being pushed

You figure things out on your own, try the obvious solution first, and escalate only when you're genuinely stuck — not as a default.



- People who write like a human, not a template

Your written English needs to be natural, warm, and persuasive. We will test this. If your application reads like it came from a form letter (or ChatGPT), it goes in the bin.



- People who are social media fluent

You understand why some DMs get replied to and most don't. You know how tone shifts across X vs. Instagram vs. Reddit. You pay attention to this stuff.



- Persistent people who don't spiral when it's slow

Most messages won't get a response. That's the job. The right person treats low reply rates as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to give up or go quiet.



- Tech-comfortable people who learn tools fast

We use a CRM and various outreach tools. We don't need a technical background, but we do need someone who reads the docs, watches the tutorial, and figures it out — not someone who sends a message every time they get confused.





*One thing we need to be upfront about*

This is a dedicated, full-time role. We need 100% of your focus — not a share of it. We've worked with VAs before who were juggling one or two other "part-time" clients. We'll ask about this directly, and we expect a straight answer. No judgment if you're in that situation — just not the right fit for us.



The flip side: strong performers earn bonuses on top of base pay, and there's real room to grow as we scale. We take really good care of people who do a good job. We want people that want to grow with us for the long term. 



*To apply — read this carefully*

Read this post carefully, especially the "Who we are looking for" section. Do those points describe you? Then tell us why — in your own words, not a template, not ChatGPT.



We read every application personally. We can immediately tell the difference between a genuine answer and a manufactured one. Be specific, be honest, and write like yourself.

Experience in any of the following will be highly advantageous:

• Amazon flat files and bulk uploads

• Inventory management systems

• Marketplace SEO and conversion optimisation

• Products with variations (size, weight, bundles, multi-SKU structures)

Working Hours

Flexible working arrangement, with expected overlap during UK business hours for coordination and communication.

title: Senior AI-First Mobile App Developer (Contract, Remote)
description:
We are hiring a senior mobile app developer to lead the build of a new consumer mobile product from MVP through launch. This is a hands-on contract role for someone who can move quickly, work independently, and use modern AI-assisted development tools as a core part of their workflow.

Because this role will involve confidential product information, shortlisted candidates will be required to sign a non-disclosure agreement before full product details, workflows, and technical specifications are shared.



Role Overview

This role is ideal for a builder who is comfortable owning execution across frontend, backend integration, and release preparation for a mobile app. We are specifically looking for a developer who already uses AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and similar platforms to accelerate development, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and testing.

The right candidate should be able to take a product from scoped requirements to a functional production-ready application, using AI tools intelligently without sacrificing code quality, architecture, security, or maintainability.

Use AI coding tools in a practical, high-output way to speed up development while maintaining strong engineering judgment.

Write production-quality, maintainable, well-structured code.

Collaborate with product and stakeholder teams to clarify scope, timelines, risks, and tradeoffs.

Help define the MVP build path, technical decisions, and launch priorities.

Support deployment, bug fixing, QA handoff, and app store submission readiness.

Proven proficiency with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor (main tool), Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

Experience working across frontend application logic, backend/API integration, authentication, state management, and performance optimization.

Solid understanding of software architecture, debugging, version control, and testing practices.

Ability to read, evaluate, and improve code generated through AI workflows.

Strong communication skills and comfort working in a fast-moving, async remote environment.



Preferred Background

Experience building cross-platform mobile apps using frameworks such as React Native, Expo, or Flutter.

Experience shipping consumer subscription apps or data-driven mobile products.

Familiarity with analytics, push notifications, third-party integrations, and production monitoring.

Experience building secure applications with privacy-conscious engineering practices.

Previous experience as a lead developer, founding engineer, or highly autonomous senior contractor.



Recommended Tech Stack

The stack below reflects our current preferred direction. Candidates do not need deep expertise in every tool listed, but should be comfortable working within a modern TypeScript-based mobile stack and making sound technical decisions across the full product lifecycle.

Mobile: React Native + Expo, TypeScript, Expo Router, Zustand + TanStack Query, NativeWind or Tamagui, React Hook Form + Zod, Victory Native or similar charting libraries, React Native Reanimated, Expo SecureStore + MMKV, WatermelonDB or SQLite-based local storage, Expo Notifications, Expo Linking, Sentry React Native, and PostHog React Native.

v for background jobs, Supabase Storage, and Resend, SendGrid, or similar transactional
 tooling.

Infrastructure / DevOps: Render, Supabase, GitHub Actions, Expo EAS Build / Submit, Sentry, Better Stack or similar monitoring tools, and Cloudflare or a comparable CDN / security layer.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who understands how to balance speed, quality, and pragmatism in an MVP environment.

description:

title: High-Performance Executive Operator (Data & Operations)
description:
This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



We are looking for a high-performance operator who can combine data intelligence with operational execution and work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is for someone who can bring structure to data, clarity to decisions, and execution to leadership initiatives.



If you thrive in fast environments, think analytically, and operate with ownership, keep reading.



Who We Are:



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to take responsibility rather than wait for instructions.



We value:

• Speed

• Accountability

• Emotional maturity

• Precision

• Needs constant praise or reassurance

You likely:



• Have experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics

• Have supported a founder or senior executive before

• Have stayed 3+ years in at least one meaningful role

• Enjoy solving complex operational problems

• Can build systems and workflows from scratch

• Communicate clearly and directly

• Are emotionally regulated and professional under pressure

• Think in outcomes and insights, not just tasks



You are someone who:



• Notices patterns others miss

• Brings clarity where others see chaos

• Moves things forward without being asked twice



Compensation & Growth:



This role offers:



• Competitive compensation aligned with performance

• Direct exposure to executive decision-making

• The opportunity to shape internal systems and operations

• Long-term growth as the company scales



At DAP Brands, we reward impact and ownership, not just tenure.



Final Note



This role is for someone who wants to build, solve, and operate at a high level.



If you enjoy working with data, solving operational problems, and supporting leadership execution, this could be an excellent fit.



If you're looking for a comfortable, slow-paced corporate role, this probably isn't it.

/careers and write MAVERICK before your name.

title: Operations & Process Manager: Real Estate & HOA Management
description:
About Us: 

Saunders HOA Management is a growing HOA management company dedicated to delivering exceptional service to our communities. We have the vision, the drive, and the foundational systems in place—but we are ready to scale across the state. To do that, we need to transition from "tribal knowledge" and daily firefighting to a highly disciplined, process-driven organization. We are looking for an execution-focused partner to help us build, refine, and enforce the systems that will fuel our growth.



The Role:

Are you someone who gets genuinely excited by a perfectly organized workflow? Do you naturally spot inefficiencies and feel a burning desire to fix them?

As our Operations & Process Manager, you will be the architect and guardian of our company’s daily operations. Your primary mission is to take the vision and processes out of the owner’s head, document them into clear, repeatable systems, and—most importantly—ensure total compliance across the team. You will be the shield that allows the leadership team to focus on scaling the business, knowing that daily operations are running flawlessly.



Key Responsibilities:

System & Process Architecture: Audit, build out, and formalize our standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all aspects of HOA management (e.g., violations, collections, vendor management, board meetings).



Compliance & Accountability: Implement weekly and monthly audit cycles to ensure staff strictly adhere to established processes. You will be the "enforcer" of our playbook.



Project Management: Oversee company-wide projects and daily task flows, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and deadlines are met.



Bottleneck Resolution: Act as the first line of defense for daily operational issues. You will troubleshoot staff roadblocks so they don't default back to the owner.



Training & Onboarding: Create training materials and onboard new staff to ensure total alignment with company systems from day one.



What Your Routine Will Look Like:



Daily: This is a full-time position and hours are Monday - Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Eastern Time. You will run morning huddles, unblock staff bottlenecks, monitor active task queues, and ensure that daily HOA deadlines (such as urgent maintenance or board requests) are met.



Weekly: Conduct process audits (spot-checking employee files/tasks for compliance), review KPIs, and hold accountability syncs with tea
mbers.



Monthly: Run deep-dive compliance reviews, update and refine SOPs based on team feedback, and report to the owner on operational health and readiness to scale.



Qualifications & Skills:



Experience: 3+ years in operations management, project management, or process improvement (Experience in HOA management, real estate, or property management is a massive plus).



The "Systemizer" Mindset: Exceptional organizational skills. You think in steps, workflows, and checklists.



High Accountability: You aren't afraid to gently but firmly hold tea
mbers accountable to standards. You believe that "if it isn't documented, it didn't happen."



Tech-Savvy: Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., ClickUp, Asana, 
) and HOA management software (e.g., AppFolio, Cinc, Tops) is highly preferred.



Problem Solver: A proactive attitude. When you see a problem, you don't just fix it for the day—you fix the system so it never happens again.



NBI Background Check: Must provide a current and clear NBI Clearance Documents.



Must speak great English and be a team player.



What We Offer:



Paid Time Off (PTO) after 6 months of employment and all US Federal Holidays



Long-Term Employment: You will be an independent contractor, but we want you to be a long-ter
mber of our team. 

A massive opportunity for career growth as we scale this company.



To Apply: Please submit your resume (with expected hourly pay rate) along with a brief cover letter explaining a specific process or system you built in a previous role that significantly improved team efficiency. Please note that all resumes without a cover letter will not be looked at.
